name: Sudden Strike
body:
Before your enemy can react, you can launch a devastating attack.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, Dex 13, favored terrain class feature.

Benefit(s): When in one of your favored terrains, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls against fl at-footed opponents.

If you successfully land your attack, your opponent is dazed for 1 round.
